text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm sorry, but could you let me 
rest here for just a little bit?
choice_data_list: Are you feeling unwell or something?
Are you feeling unwell or something?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No... yesterday, a friend asked me to help 
out with some accumulated chores...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So ever since this morning, I've been 
doing laundry, cleaning the place up, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It was really fun, but... the amount was 
way more than I expected...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Perhaps I ended up getting a 
little carried away...
